source_documents.title: From dark TICT state to Emissive quasi-TICT State: The AIE Mechanism of N-(3-(benzo[d]oxazol-2-yl)phenyl)-4-tert-butylbenzamide

reference_evidence_units.quote: The fluorescence quantum yield of 3OTB powder is 8±2%, 47times higher than that of THF solution (0.17%)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB

reference_evidence_units.quote: with increase of solvent polarity, the TICT emission red shifts together with a decrease of the relative intensity
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB

reference_evidence_units.quote: Due to these weak interactions, the free configuration twist is partially restricted and a quasi-TICT* state can be formed
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal contacts partially restrict the twist: emissive quasi-TICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: With increasing ordering of molecular arrangements, intramolecular rotation is more restricted and correspondingly, the quasi-TICT* emission becomes stronger.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: More order, more restriction, stronger quasi-TICT emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: while the electron transition in 1x* (λcal = 479 nm, f= 0.003)
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Relaxed TICT is dark (f 0.003) vs LE (f 0.877).

reference_evidence_units.quote: replaced by the structured phosphorescence (with detecting lifetime longer than µs magnitude, see Figure S6).
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB
reference_evidence_units.statement: Structured phosphorescence at the lowest temperatures.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the calculated absorption spectra and maximum wavelengths of the selected dimer from crystal structures show almost no spectral shift when compared with monomer
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3OTB dimer

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Partial restriction of the twist by packing creates the emissive quasi-TICT state; more order gives stronger emission.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Emission comes from a quasi-TICT state that stops short of the dark relaxed TICT minimum.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Oscillator strength falls from LE to relaxed TICT; the quasi-TICT keeps some brightness.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Phosphorescence appears only at low temperature.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Partial restriction of the twist by packing creates the emissive quasi-TICT state; more order gives stronger emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Emission comes from a quasi-TICT state that stops short of the dark relaxed TICT minimum.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The hydroxyl of the parent HBX is absent; the meta amide N-H cannot H-bond to the benzoxazole N.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Not discussed for this molecule in the source.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: A computed crystal dimer shows no spectral shift (E07); used to reject LE assignment, not an explicit exclusion of exciton coupling.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Oscillator strength falls from LE to relaxed TICT; the quasi-TICT keeps some brightness.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Phosphorescence appears only at low temperature.
